jobs.location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description: ✨ Sangfor Internship for Future Talents｜Jakarta, Indonesia Sangfor Technologies is a global leading provider of IT infrastructure solutions, focusing on Cloud Computing & Network Security. Founded in 2000, we have over 9,500 employees and 60+ branch offices worldwide, including our Indonesia office in Jakarta. We are launching our paid internship program (3–6 months) and looking for motivated final-year students & fresh graduates to join our team as Field Application Engineer / Presales Engineer / Sales Intern ! 🎯 Basic Requirements Final-year university students or fresh graduates, Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Systems or related majors Able to work on-site at our Jakarta office 💼 Role Highlights 🔹 Field Application Engineer Intern Provide on-site & remote technical support for customers, handle POC and after-sales inquiries Track, manage and resolve incidents, prepare customer-facing reports Conduct device installation & integration at customer environments 🔹 Presales Engineer Intern Identify requirements & business opportunities from customer/partner meetings, build technical solution strategies Analyze client requirements, map risks & constraints, recommend suitable project approaches Prepare presentations, cost estimations and support full project lifecycle planning 🔹 Sales Intern Identify, recruit and collaborate with distributors & value-added resellers to develop new business and retain existing customers Engage and motivate channel partners, design sales & marketing initiatives to drive revenue growth Discover new sales opportunities and maintain long-term healthy customer relationships 🎁 What We Offer ✅ Paid internship allowance ✅ Clear full-time conversion opportunity after internship ✅ Team building, birthday gifts, festival gifts and regular department activities ✅ Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge cloud & cybersecurity industry, global platform resources 📩 Contact: nina.sun@sangfor.com
